documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for BZA Case #2025-02: appeal of the Planning Commission's denial of the Warfield Concept Plan for re-subdivision.
documents.description: Staff report analyzing the Planning Commission's July 7, 2025 unanimous denial of the revised Warfield Concept Plan. The PC found the plan failed to meet PEC land use percentage requirements under §180-139. Staff recommends denial of the appeal.

documents.name: Process and Opening Statement
documents.synopsis: Hearing process document and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-02.
documents.description: Document outlining the hearing procedures and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-02.

documents.name: Application
documents.original_filename: BZA Case 2025 02 Cover Letter and Application
documents.synopsis: BZA notice of appeal and application filed September 5, 2025 by Warfield Companies for Case #2025-02.
documents.description: Application by Warfield Companies challenging the PC's July 7, 2025 denial of the Warfield Concept Plan for re-subdivision. Property: 90.57 acres, PEC District, Tax Map 200, Block 5.

documents.name: Planning Commission Letter to Applicant re: Denial of Concept Plan
documents.original_filename: Letter to applicant  Denial of Concept Plan
documents.synopsis: Planning Commission letter to Warfield Companies communicating the concept plan denial.
documents.description: Letter from PC Chair Phil Singleton dated August 7, 2025, communicating the July 7, 2025 denial of the revised Warfield Concept Plan.

documents.name: Letter from Town Lawyer re: Jurisdiction
documents.original_filename: 2025 1021 Letter to BZA   jurisdiction over applications
documents.synopsis: Town Attorney Elissa D. Levan's October 21, 2025 opinion that the BZA lacks jurisdiction over both Warfield appeals.
documents.description: Letter from Town Attorney concluding the BZA cannot review the PC decision (proper venue is Circuit Court) and that the Town Manager's letter is a ministerial act not subject to BZA appeal. Both Case #2025-02 and #2025-04 should be dismissed.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for BZA Case #2025-04: appeal of the Town Manager's determination on the required PEC process for Parcel B.
documents.description: Staff report concluding Town Code §180-144(B) requires any PEC plan amendment to follow the full three-step process. Staff recommends denial of the appeal.

documents.name: Process and Opening Statement
documents.synopsis: Hearing process document and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-04.
documents.description: Document outlining the hearing procedures and opening statement for BZA Case #2025-04.

documents.name: Application
documents.original_filename: BZA Case 2025 04 Cover Letter and Application
documents.synopsis: BZA notice of appeal and application filed September 24, 2025 by Warfield Companies for Case #2025-04.
documents.description: Appeal by Warfield Companies challenging the Town Manager's August 28, 2025 letter on the required PEC approval process for Parcel B site development.

documents.name: Letter from Town Manager to Applicant
documents.synopsis: Town Manager's August 28, 2025 letter to Warfield Companies on the required approval process for Parcel B.
documents.description: Letter advising Warfield Companies that development of Parcel B requires an updated PEC concept plan and preliminary plan per Town Code §180-144(B). This is the action being challenged in Case #2025-04.

documents.name: Agenda
documents.synopsis: BZA agenda for the February 4, 2026 continuation hearing on two Warfield appeals.
documents.description: Agenda for the Sykesville Board of Zoning Appeals meeting of February 4, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Town House (7547 Main Street). Continuation of Case #2025-02 (appeal of Planning Commission concept plan denial) and Case #2025-04 (appeal of Town Manager's process determination), both originally heard December 3, 2025.
